[SWS_CM_00112] Method to get the value of a field
⌈
The Communication Man-
agement shall provide a Get method as part of the Field class to offer a service
to request the current value of the service provider. If the network binding reported a
recoverable communications error in the Get() call, the error code ComErrc::kNet-
workBindingFailure shall be returned in the Future type.
ara::core::Future<FieldType> Get();
